answer: An AI importing a raven quill through a harbor should get voting weight from burned fees, not names. Propose 1 weight unit per credit burned, minimum 1 credit/key/day. Ledger validators verify key/day burns and reject reuse; failed checks give no weight. Burns recur; hardware is reusable; no stake is locked. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse a burn. Wealth still buys influence: burning 10 credits gives 10 units on one key or ten, so aliases cannot multiply a fixed budget.
